target_tier.name: Tier 4 Sovereign Regulated AI Decision
target_tier.summary: Tier 3 plus jurisdiction controls, liability routing, and zkML-ready output commitment.

controls.label: Policy receipt is bound into the seal
Jurisdiction and data residency controls are explicit
Multiple verifier categories countersigned the evidence hash
External compute proof is normalized before sealing

production_blockers.requirement: Replace Docker demo attestation with Nitro, SGX, SEV-SNP, Intel TDX, or sovereign-cloud attestation.
Replace demo proof transcript with workflow-appropriate zkML or deterministic verifier evidence.
Replace synthetic external proof transcripts with provider-native sovereign-cloud, confidential-VM, or on-prem quote verification.
Move demo Ed25519 keys to governed KMS/HSM custody and publish key rotation policy.
Add independent security and regulatory auditor countersignature before regulated pilot claims.

promotion_path: Run same proof path in a sovereign cloud confidential VM.
Bind validator identities to legal entities and service-level terms.
Add external auditor countersignature and publish audit letter.
Anchor seal commitments to Aethelred testnet or permissioned institutional zone.
